title: Text: DET R.J. Burgess ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Although Al doesn’t have to answer to anyone but Chris and ultimately can make the decision himself, all our Crosscheckers and Scott Pleis are meeting in Lakeland as we speak discussing who we take lol...so it would be weird to confirm who we’re taking before Al and David even get to Lakeland
Also pretty much no organization has done that before the draft since ive been paying attention
But I asked Al if I should get a flight to Raleigh, where Auburn is in regionals, and he said yeah

With, in all honesty, less inside knowledge than you (since I don’t talk to Al and David everyday) I’m basically functioning under the assumption that we’re taking Mize. I legitimately have less knowledge than you on that though.
No chance he's going to say that tomorrow though
